title: File Creation & Naming Standards
purpose: Establishes mandatory naming patterns, directory placement rules, and file size budgets for all repository resources. Addresses the naming inconsistencies found by A1-Alpha audit: mixed case in storage/scripts/ (50/50 snake/kebab split), SOP filename/ID mismatches (SOP-026 through SOP-028), and same-concept-different-names across index files.

section_1_creation_decision.title: When to Create a New File vs Extend Existing

rules.rule: Check for duplicates before creating any file
rules.action: Search index.json for the resource type. Grep for key terms. If a file covers >50% of the same topic, extend it instead.
rules.evidence: A1-Alpha found KB-0012 and KB-0013 with identical titles, SRC-0018 and SRC-0039 both describing FRED API.

rules.action: If a file covers two distinct topics, split it. If two files cover the same topic, merge them.
rules.exception: Index files aggregate multiple entries by design.

rules.action: If an existing file is outdated, update it with a _v2 suffix rather than creating a new file with a different name. Mark the old version as superseded in the index.

pre_creation_checklist: Search the relevant index.json for duplicate or overlapping entries
Verify the next available sequential ID for the resource type
Confirm the correct target directory per section_3
Verify the filename matches the pattern in section_2
Check that the file fits within its token budget per section_4

section_2_naming_patterns.title: Mandatory Naming Patterns by Resource Type
section_2_naming_patterns.description: Every file must match its resource type pattern exactly. No exceptions.

patterns.notes: Title is in YAML frontmatter, not filename. Sequential IDs, no gaps.
Title is in YAML frontmatter. One log per team session.

patterns.case: snake_case filename, UPPER prefix in ID field
patterns.notes: Descriptor is 2-5 words in snake_case. Versioned files add _v2 suffix: sop_012_monitoring_intervention_v2.json
Descriptor is the API/service name in kebab-case, 1-3 words.

patterns.id_format: SCR-NNNN in index only (not in filename)
patterns.notes: All scripts use snake_case regardless of language. No kebab-case scripts. Reports use kebab-case .md extension.

patterns.case: snake_case for .py files, kebab-case for directories
patterns.notes: Python files follow PEP 8 snake_case. Tool directories use kebab-case.
Always at directory root alongside index.json. Extension matches the format of entries in that directory.
One per directory containing indexed resources. Schema per SOP-030.
Standard Python module naming. Prefix grouping allowed (sdk_*, bus_*).
All team output files in */output/ directories use snake_case consistently.

section_3_directory_placement.title: Directory Placement Rules
section_3_directory_placement.description: Every resource type has exactly one correct directory. Do not place files elsewhere.

directory_naming_rules.exception: Python package directories with __init__.py may use snake_case per PEP 8.

directory_naming_rules.rule: Maximum 4 levels of nesting from repo root
directory_naming_rules.rationale: Deeper nesting increases token cost per path reference. Current deepest paths are 5-6 levels (storage/coordination/teams/*/output/) which is at the limit.

directory_naming_rules.rule: Do not create new top-level directories without coordinator approval
directory_naming_rules.rationale: Current top-level structure (knowledge-base, market-research, prototype, storage, teams) is stable.

section_4_file_size_budgets.title: Token Budget Categories
section_4_file_size_budgets.description: Every file has a target token budget based on its category. Files exceeding their budget should be split.

categories.name: micro
categories.use_case: Navigation aids, metadata-only files, small configs

categories.name: medium
categories.use_case: Entries requiring structured procedures or multi-section analysis

categories.name: large
categories.use_case: Rare. Only for entries that cannot be meaningfully split. Must include a summary in the first 500 bytes.

mandatory_summary_rule.rule: Any file exceeding 2000 tokens MUST have a summary field or section in the first 500 bytes
mandatory_summary_rule.rationale: Agents reading the first 500 bytes should be able to decide whether to read the rest. Saves 80% of wasted reads on irrelevant large files.
mandatory_summary_rule.format_json: Top-level "summary" field before any arrays or detailed content
mandatory_summary_rule.format_markdown: A ## Summary section immediately after frontmatter, before ## Context
mandatory_summary_rule.evidence: Think-tank-beta A1-TC03: Five KB entries exceed 25KB (167KB total, ~42,000 tokens). A mandatory summary enables selective reading.

split_guidance.rule: Files exceeding their budget should be split into summary + detail
split_guidance.rationale: The summary covers 80% of use cases at 10% of the token cost.

rules.case: kebab-case for data files, UPPER_CASE for templates/docs
snake_case for SOPs/configs, kebab-case for data, lowercase for index

section_6_common_mistakes.title: Common Mistakes to Avoid
section_6_common_mistakes.description: Based on the A1-Alpha file pattern audit findings.

mistakes.mistake: Mixing kebab-case and snake_case in the same directory
mistakes.evidence: storage/scripts/ has 18 snake_case and 15 kebab-case files for the same type of resource
mistakes.fix: All scripts use snake_case. Rename kebab-case scripts.

mistakes.mistake: SOP files without the sop_NNN_ prefix
Placing files in the wrong directory
mistakes.evidence: TEAM-0022-config.json and TEAM-0022-pipeline.py at teams/ root instead of teams/sessions/. Team comm dirs at /teams/ instead of storage/coordination/teams/.

mistakes.mistake: Creating duplicate entries for the same concept
mistakes.evidence: KB-0012 and KB-0013 identical titles. SRC-0018 and SRC-0039 both describe FRED API.
mistakes.fix: Always search before creating. Use pre_creation_checklist.

mistakes.mistake: Using different field names for the same concept across indexes

mistakes.evidence: Found in prototype/, storage/api-tools/, storage/coordination/, storage/scripts/
mistakes.fix: Add __pycache__/ to .gitignore. Never commit compiled artifacts.

mistakes.mistake: Storing derived data in index files
mistakes.evidence: tag_index, categories, by_data_type, by_access_type, language_index are all derivable from entries array
mistakes.fix: Per SOP-030, indexes contain only canonical data. Derived views computed on demand.

before_creating_any_file: Searched index.json for duplicates or overlapping entries
Identified the correct resource type from section_2
Verified the next sequential ID is correct
Filename matches the mandatory pattern for its type
Target directory matches section_3 placement rules
File will fit within its token budget category from section_4
Case convention matches section_5 rules for the file extension
after_creating_a_file: File passes the naming pattern regex for its type
File is in the correct directory
If >2000 tokens, summary field/section is present in first 500 bytes
